Subject: Vendor portal OTPs arriving in bursts / can't complete signup

Hi Ben,

We're seeing a handful of our vendors fail to finish the supplier portal onboarding this morning. When they click the invite link to accept our invite (Coupa tenant), they sometimes get a '503 Service Unavailable' page immediately after clicking 'Send OTP'. In other cases the portal sends 3–4 OTP emails in a minute, and the first OTP expires before they can use it.

Three affected vendors so far:
- OceanHarvest Ltd (maria@oceanharvest.com)
- Keystone Parts (accounts@keystoneparts.com)
- Arrow Marine (vendor@arrowmarine.com)

Attached is a screenshot one vendor sent of the queued OTP box and a short timestamped log they captured. Can you please unlock those vendor accounts and re-send invites while you investigate? This is blocking PO submission for two urgent suppliers.

Thanks,

Vendor Operations — Greensail Logistics

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor portal OTPs arriving in bursts / can't complete signup

Quick summary of what I see in the infra metrics and logs (preliminary):

- Between 09:05–09:30 PT on 2027-05-22 there were repeated POSTs to /auth/send-otp from a small Greensail proxy cluster. Many of those POSTs returned 503s from the auth gateway. The proxy appears to be retrying on 502/503, causing duplicate OTP requests within seconds.
- The OTP endpoint is currently stateless and issues a new code per request; duplicate requests therefore trigger multiple emails.
- There are also a few SAML assertion errors in the tenant logs where RelayState was truncated after the LB retried, which explains the random 503 page you saw in the browser.

Immediate technical mitigations we can push:
1) Turn on sticky sessions (LB cookie) for the auth gateway for tenant-bound requests so retry-induced RelayState truncation is far less likely.
2) Configure the proxy (CloudFront/edge) to not retry POSTs to /auth/send-otp or to reduce retries from 3 -> 1.
3) Make OTP issuance idempotent for a short window: if the same request fingerprint arrives within N seconds, return the same OTP instead of creating a new one.
4) Increase OTP TTL by 2 minutes as a short-term customer-facing mitigation.

I've attached the gateway dump for the 09:05 window and the request headers we saw.

Attachments: gateway-503-20270522.log (text/plain), otp-request-headers.txt (text/plain), saml-response-sample.xml (application/xml)

I'll prepare a small config change bundle and can roll the sticky-session + retry rule to a canary tenant later today if you want.

Jonas
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greensail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal OTPs arriving in bursts / can't complete signup

Thanks Jonas — our SRE team temporarily disabled proxy retries for POSTs and ran a quick test. With retries off, the signup flow completes consistently (we saw a single OTP email and the browser advanced to the token screen).

Can you please:
- Manually unlock the three vendor accounts I listed (OceanHarvest, Keystone Parts, Arrow Marine).
- Resend the invites, ideally with OTP TTL extended so they have time to paste the code.
- As a stopgap, provide a one-time magic link or extended link expiry for those three invites (we'll still patch server-side but need these POs in the system today).

We're happy to be the canary if you want to roll sticky sessions + idempotency to our tenant first.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Liam
